a1-s01.text: You wake in the firewood shed of the Xuanshan Sect. Three hundred years pass like a dream that never quite lifted, and the snow outside falls without a sound. Someone is calling your name, and the word they use is 'master' — you do not remember taking a disciple.

a1-s02.text: Nine of them stand outside, each with a breath like a deep well. The first kneels into the snow, looks up, and says: master, the ten thousand clans are here again. Your own voice comes out level. You ask him: which clan, this time.
